title: Egregopathy
listing_description: A theory of collective pathology that traces how institutions can normalize deception, extraction, and cruelty even when no individual member appears to own the whole outcome.
reader_hook: Start with the crime that has no single criminal and ask how organizations can be designed to reconnect knowledge, responsibility, and the people who bear costs.
